full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a cut section of an excised adrenal gland specimen against a blue background with a metric scale. The specimen displays a well-circumscribed, brownish cortical nodule or tumor within the adrenal tissue. The cut surface reveals a relatively homogeneous, fleshy lesion measuring approximately 2.5 cm across. The macroscopic appearance is characteristic of a benign adrenal cortical adenoma or nodular hyperplasia.
